text:
After a peaceful afternoon, we are grateful for your careful letter, and we are sorry to learn that your journey was disrupted when your travel with a companion animal did not connect as planned. We understand how unsettling this would have been, especially when you had already prepared carefully for your animal's comfort and for the handover process at the airport.

Our review shows that the missed connection arose from a sequence of operational delays that affected the transfer of your party between services, and we appreciate the patience you showed while waiting for assistance. <<FACT F110>> The desk has also recorded the service change in our ledger so that the welfare coordinator and the passenger coordinator can review the handling of future cases in a more consistent way.

For companion animal travel, our priority is always the safety, calm, and dignity of the animal, along with clear communication to the traveler. In this instance, we recognize that the disruption created avoidable worry and that the support provided on the day did not meet the standard we aim to uphold at Aurelia Skyways. We have asked the relevant teams to revisit the transfer steps, with particular attention to escort procedures, handoff clarity, and contingency planning when a connection is at risk.

Please be assured that your comments have been taken seriously. We will continue to work with our operations colleagues so that the Companion Animal Travel Desk can respond more effectively when disruption affects a journey involving an animal companion. If you travel with us again, we will do our best to provide a smoother experience and more visible assistance throughout the process.

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention and for giving us the opportunity to improve our service. We remain committed to responsible care and respectful support for every traveler and every animal in our care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
